concerns.text: Task T006 (Synthetic Generation) is marked [ ] (incomplete) but is a strict prerequisite for T014, T021, T041, and the entire US1/US2/US3 pipeline. The spec (FR-001) and plan require ingestion of calibrated images and ground-truth generation. Without T006 completion, the deliverable for FR-001 (ingesting images) and SC-004 (power analysis on n=50) cannot be produced, effectively weakening the requirement to 'generate synthetic data' without a mechanism to do so.

Tasks T028 and T031 are blocked by T009 (Real HST Validation) and T006 (Synthetic Generation). T009 is marked [X] (complete) while T006 is [ ]. This creates a logical contradiction where the pipeline claims to have the qualitative validation data (T009) but lacks the quantitative ground truth (T006) required to perform the validation (T028/T031). The task list implies the validation can proceed without the synthetic ground truth, violating FR-007 (validate on held-out subset with known bias) and Constitution Principle IV (Single Source of Truth).

Task T024 (Sensitivity Analysis Sweep) is marked [ ] (incomplete). The spec (SC-003) mandates a sensitivity analysis sweeping saturation fraction. T024 is the only task explicitly responsible for generating the `saturation_sweep.csv` artifact required to verify monotonic trends. Leaving this task incomplete means the success criterion SC-003 cannot be met, representing a silent relaxation of the spec's requirement for a full sensitivity sweep.

Task T030 (Power Analysis) is marked [ ] (incomplete). SC-004 explicitly requires a power analysis confirming n=50 achieves ≥80% power or documenting the limitation. T030 is the sole task implementing this check. Its incompleteness means the project cannot satisfy SC-004, violating the spec's mandatory success criteria.

Task T027 (Regression) is marked [X] (complete) but has a 'Blocking Condition' note stating it requires T009 (Real HST) to be complete. While T009 is marked [X], T006 (Synthetic Generation) is [ ]. Since T027 requires data from US1/US2 (which depend on T006), marking T027 as complete while its upstream data source (T006) is incomplete is a semantic weakening of the dependency chain. The task cannot be 'complete' without the data it consumes.
